step_sql:
SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) AS gmv
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = o.region_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND r.region_name = '华东'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY gmv DESC

WITH category_sales AS (
  SELECT p.category, SUM(o.pay_amount) AS gmv
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
  JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = o.region_id
  WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND r.region_name = '华东'
  GROUP BY p.category
  ORDER BY gmv DESC
  LIMIT 3
),
product_sales AS (
  SELECT p.category, p.product_name, SUM(o.pay_amount) AS gmv
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
  JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = o.region_id
  WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND r.region_name = '华东'
  GROUP BY p.category, p.product_name
)
SELECT ps.category, ps.product_name, ROUND(ps.gmv, 2) AS gmv
FROM product_sales ps
JOIN category_sales cs ON cs.category = ps.category
ORDER BY ps.category, ps.gmv DESC

deepseek-flash.question: GMV超过3万的客户按地区统计人数
deepseek-flash.answer:
当前结果不足以给出“GMV超过3万元的客户按地区统计人数”的完整答案。用于最终统计的 [s2] 虽然输出了 4 行地区人数，但其 SQL 先按 customer_id、region_id 分组，再对每个“客户-地区”组合累计 pay_amount 并筛选 >30000，分组粒度和过滤口径与“按客户总 GMV 超过 3 万、同一客户只计一次”不一致，因此该步结果不可用，不能引用其中的地区人数 [s2]。

[s1] 的 SQL 按客户汇总 pay_amount 并筛选 >30000，符合客户明细核对目的 [s1]；但结果共 52 行、仅展示前 50 行，未展示行不能用于汇总或排名，所以也无法据 [s1] 完整汇总出各地区人数 [s1]。当前缺少一个未截断、按客户总 GMV>30000 筛选后以客户去重并按地区计数的步骤。

局限：地区为空或未知时如何处理，[s1]、[s2] 均未明确展示；[s2] 口径与问题不一致，[s1] 明细被截断，均不能作为最终地区人数结论 [s1][s2]。
step_sql:
SELECT c.customer_name, r.region_name, ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) AS gmv
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = c.region_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name, r.region_name
HAVING SUM(o.pay_amount) > 30000

SELECT r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT t.customer_id) AS customer_count
FROM (
  SELECT o.customer_id, o.region_id
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.status = 'paid'
  GROUP BY o.customer_id, o.region_id
  HAVING SUM(o.pay_amount) > 30000
) t
JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = t.region_id
GROUP BY r.region_name
